scientific_scope_status: Let H=(V,E) be a finite simple graph with n vertices and m>=1 edges, p>1 and B>1. Kernels W:[0,1]^2->[0,infinity) are nonnegative, symmetric, have row integral exactly one almost everywhere and ||W||_p<=B. The observable is t(H,W)=integral product_{uv in E} W(x_u,x_v); discrepancy is the usual cut norm, not merely pairwise pointwise or operator approximation.
